notes.subject: חדק / מסוכה
notes.rationale: Brier and thorn-hedge escalate the plant-thorn imagery; the hedge (fence) that should guard is now the sharpest danger.

notes.subject: מצפיך
notes.rationale: 'Your watchmen' — either God's appointed watchmen whose day has come, or a rare form of צפה 'watching'; KJV/ASV keep 'thy watchmen', JPS 'thy watchmen' too.

notes.subject: bilong yu
notes.rationale: The speaker turns to address Yahwe directly — 'your visitation, your watchmen' — a shift into second-person prayer.

translation: Gutpela man long olgeta em i olsem wanpela nil; man i stretpela tru em i sot moa long banis nail; de bilong ol man i lukluk, de bilong yu yu kam skelim, i kamap pinis; nau taim ol i no save long wanem ol i ken wokim.
